text: Loneliness does not come from having no people about one, but from being unable to communicate the things that seem important to oneself.
author: Carl Jung

archive.text: Research your own experience, absorb what is useful, reject what is useless, add what is essentially your own.

archive.author: Sadhguru

archive.text: In seed time learn, in harvest teach, in winter enjoy.
archive.author: William Blake

archive.author: Laurence J. Peter

archive.text: Of course I am not worried about intimidating men. The type of man who will be intimidated by me is exactly the type of man I have no interest in.
archive.author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie

archive.text: Excess of liberty, whether it lies in state or individuals, seems only to pass into excess of slavery.
archive.author: Plato

archive.text: We do not content ourselves with the life we have in ourselves and in our own being; we desire to live an imaginary life in the mind of others, and for this purpose we endeavour to shine.
archive.author: Blaise Pascal
